name: 8-Track Raven
description: 8-Track Raven is a modular cassette-based automated filament changer for Klipper printers. It is a simplified, lower-cost alpha variant of the full 8-Track system, retaining the same cassette design but using off-the-shelf MCU boards instead of custom electronics. Each cassette is a self-contained filament management unit with its own NEMA 17 stepper motor and MG 996R servo, using BMG gears for filament drive. Cassettes are interchangeable and forward-compatible with the full 8-Track system.
features: Fixed cassette dimensions for forward compatibility
Custom PCBs with pogo pin connections between cassettes and hub
BMG extruder gear drive per cassette
One-way bearing to prevent filament backslip
Magnetic positioning with endstop microswitch per cassette
Uses off-the-shelf BTT MMB CAN board
